name: Arm Ergometer
steps: Adjust the seat height so the arm ergometer crank axis sits near shoulder height, sit tall, and grasp both handles.
Brace your core lightly and keep your chest upright with shoulders relaxed down.
Push one handle smoothly forward as you pull the other toward you in continuous alternating circles.
Maintain an even cadence and resistance for the target duration or distance, then slow the crank gradually to a stop.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your reaching elbow instead of locking it hard on each revolution.
Avoid rocking your torso forward and back to force heavy resistance.
